description: Report an issue with an event listing. Anyone can flag an event as wrong, gone, cancelled, postponed or moved to a new date (rescheduled, with `newStartDate`); an admin reviews every request, none is applied on its own. Browser forms pass Turnstile; programmatic callers send an API key instead.

kind.description: postponed: new date to come; rescheduled: it has a new date (give it as newStartDate)

newStartDate.description: For a rescheduled request: the event's new start date

name: request_event_correction
title: Report an issue with an event listing
